description: A page of a notebook's notes, in a tab of its own: a title and, under it, the page's Markdown text drawn as it reads, edited in place. Pages link to each other, name things with @, and take changes Meta proposes. Every notebook has a page called Home that cannot be renamed or deleted.
opens: click a page in the Pages list
New page (+ in the list, New Page… in its menu)
Meta's action card for a page

parts.name: find bar
parts.shows: Hidden normally; when open it sits over the top of the page, above the title: a search box (placeholder "Find"), a count "3 of 12" (dimmed, small) at its right, an up and a down arrow button (tooltips "Previous match (Shift+Enter)" and "Next match (Enter)"), and a close button. Every match is shaded, the current one more. The title is searched too. Finds what is seen as it reads (not the hidden Markdown marks).

actions.does: Opens the bar with the selected text (one line) in it, and focuses it.
Next match.
Previous match.
Closes the bar; the caret stays where it is.
Closes the bar and the caret goes where clicked.

parts.name: title
parts.shows: A frameless text entry at the top, large, bold, in the page's own short name (Plans for Work:Plans; the full name is its tooltip when it has a parent). Home's is not editable. As you type, the Pages list and the tab show the typed name at once; it is kept when you leave the box or press Enter. While Meta's change to the page is not kept or undone, the title's text is highlighted exactly as the page's row in the Pages list is (green added, blue moved, the edited colour, the accent highlighted), lit more with it while the pointer is over the change's card; the find bar's matches are shaded over it.

decisions.said: When a page is added or deleted, its title should take the highlight its row has in the left bar
decisions.rule: Every app highlights a page's title as the page's row in the pages list is highlighted, in the same colour, strike and brightness, for as long as the row is

actions.does: Renames the page (with its sub-pages and every [[link]] to any of them, their tabs following) and moves into the text, caret at the start. A name another page has already stays in the box and a toast says "There's a page called {name} already".
Lets go of what was typed (own name back) and moves to the text, caret where it was.

actions.by: key Up on the text's first line
actions.does: Up into the title, the caret about straight above where it was.
Renames the page.

parts.name: text
parts.shows: The page's Markdown, drawn as it reads in a column 820 wide (or the whole pane with Full-width text), centred. The Markdown marks are hidden except on the lines the caret or selection is on (Settings → Markup visibility: that, never, or always but a link's). Left margin 22. Drawn: # to ###### headings (largest first, bold and heavier; the fourth the text's size, the fifth and sixth smaller; the third and deeper in grey), **bold** or __bold__, *italic* or _italic_, ~~struck~~, ==marked== (yellow background), `code` (monospace, grey background), > quotes (grey italic, indented), --- rules (a line is drawn), lists with - * + drawn as • (solid, hollow ◦ a level in, then solid) and numbers 1. in a grey bold, a task's [ ] and [x] drawn as boxes ☐ and ☑, a ``` block as a card as in Baude's chat, [text](url) and bare web addresses as underlined links in the accent colour, [[Page]] and [[Page|label]] as links showing the name or label (grey italic when that page has nothing written yet), @name as a green bold chip with the logo of what it is, -- typed with space around it becoming an em dash (not in code). A passage Meta changed is tinted green until kept. Misspellings get a red squiggle and grammar errors a blue one (Settings → Check Spelling).

actions.does: Opens that page in a tab, made if there is none yet; the caret and selection stay where they were. With Alt or Shift held, or a double click, it is the text's own (caret, selection).

Opens it where it is: a notebook or page opens in Record; a chat on a Read tab; a file on a Code tab; a branch on Git; a Kubernetes object or table in their views; a pull request or issue on its web page; a name that has nowhere to open shows its card (what it is) in a toast. Not found: toast "@{name}: not found in {folders}" or "@{name}: open a chat to look it up in its folder".

Opens it in the system's browser. A citation link to a passage of a chat (made by Copy citation link on a Read tab) opens that chat on a Read tab at the passage, shaded; toast "That chat isn't on this computer" if its transcript is not there.
Pointer becomes a hand. Over an @name, after a short rest, a card (RecordNameCard).
After a short pause the selected passage (more than 2 characters, what is proposed in it left out) is quoted to Meta with where it is (RecordMeta).
Next item (a number one more, a box not ticked); Enter on an empty item ends the list. Shift+Enter a line of the item's text under it.

actions.by: key Tab / Shift+Tab in a list item
actions.does: Indent or outdent the item (a level is two spaces).

actions.by: key Backspace right after a bullet
actions.does: Outdent one level, or at the left remove the bullet and make the line text.

actions.by: key Alt+Up / Alt+Down on a heading or list item
actions.does: Moves it up or down past its sibling, all under it going with it (Org-mode style).

actions.by: key Alt+Left / Alt+Right on a heading
actions.does: Alt+Left moves that heading one level toward #, Alt+Right one deeper (one mark added), with the lines selected every heading in them; Shift too: its children's levels go with it. Nothing happens past levels 1 to 6.
Wraps the selection in bold, code or italic marks.

actions.by: key Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y (Cmd on macOS)
actions.does: Undo and redo, kept per page (up to 1000 steps; a run of letters is one step to a word; what Meta proposes is in none of it).

actions.by: paste a web address over a selection
actions.does: The selection becomes a link [selection](address).

actions.by: key Backspace or Delete at a link's edge
actions.does: A link's hidden marks are never broken into: Backspace after it takes its name's last letter, Delete before it its first; with none left the link goes. A pull request's or issue's #12 goes whole.

actions.by: key Ctrl+Plus / Ctrl+Minus / Ctrl+0 (Cmd on macOS)
actions.does: Zooms the notes' text (and the chat read and Meta's conversation with it); 0 goes back to Settings' Global Scale.

parts.name: @ list
parts.shows: Typing @ (after a space or at a line start) opens a list under the caret, searched as you type (what is typed after the @, spaces and all, each word found in any order, best match first; @{ allows spaces and closing } ). Each row: the logo of its kind, the name, and under it "{kind} · {summary}" (hovering that shows when/how long ago). It lists the notebooks, their pages, every chat by its title, and what the folder of the chat being read has (files, branches, Kubernetes objects, database tables, pull requests and issues). The list's foot says "{n} found", "Nothing found", or "Nothing found · open a chat for its folder's names". The typed @word is coloured as an @name; the folder's names come in a part at a time while it is catalogued.

actions.does: Moves in the list.
Takes the picked row: the @name is written in (a name with spaces as @{name}).
Same.
Leaves it, what was typed stays.
Closes it and selects text.

parts.name: # list
parts.shows: Typing # after a space, bracket or at a line start (not a line's first # with nothing after it, a heading's; not in code) lists GitHub's pull requests and issues of the chat read's folder, as long as what is typed still asks for them (a number, or words). Same layout as the @ list. Enter when nothing was picked is a new line.

actions.does: Writes the picked one in as an @ reference.

parts.name: + list
parts.shows: Typing + (after a space or line start) lists this page's sub-pages first, then the notebook's other pages, each row "Sub-page" or "Page" with the first non-empty line of the page as its summary (or "nothing in it yet"), last a row "New sub-page" with "of {page}" when no page has that name yet. The foot says "{n} page(s)" or "No page named that yet". Enter with nothing picked is a new line. Typing +Ideas then a space or Enter turns it into a link [[+Ideas]] to this page's sub-page Ideas (made empty, grey in the Pages list until written in).

actions.by: key Enter / Tab / click a row
actions.does: Writes the link, as [[page]] (or [[+Name]] for a sub-page).

states.name: Home
states.shows: Title cannot be edited. A notebook made by Meta or by hand starts with it. The heading "To learn" on it holds words added from Meta's "Not in your notes" chips.

states.name: new page
states.shows: Empty text and the title ready to type; the page is made but listed grey in Pages and not kept as a file while empty (an empty page that nothing links to goes when its tab closes).

states.name: page changed elsewhere
states.shows: Another Record or Meta changed it: shown again with the caret kept and nothing to undo.

states.name: page deleted by Meta
states.shows: Listed struck through in the Pages list; clicking its row there, or the page on the change's card, opens a read-only tab titled "{page} (deleted)" (trash icon, tooltip "{page}: deleted by Meta; undo brings it back"), laid out as a page is: its title and its text as they were, all of it struck through on red as its row is, until the change is kept or undone (then the tab closes).

decisions.said: Going into a deleted page's content, the whole of it should be highlighted in red
decisions.rule: Every app opens a page deleted but not yet kept from its row in the pages list as well as from the change's card, and shows all of it, title and text, highlighted red and struck through as its row is
